wikidot5e:spell:fire-bolt.effectSummary: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature or object within 120 feet. On a hit it takes 1d10 fire damage, and a flammable unattended object ignites. Damage becomes 2d10 at character level 5, 3d10 at level 11, and 4d10 at level 17.

wikidot5e:spell:fire-shield.effectSummary: For 10 minutes, wispy flames surround you, shedding bright light for 10 feet and dim light for another 10 feet; you can dismiss them as an action. Choose a warm shield or chill shield. A warm shield gives resistance to cold damage and deals 2d8 fire damage to a creature within 5 feet whenever it hits you with a melee attack. A chill shield gives resistance to fire damage and deals 2d8 cold damage under the same condition.

wikidot5e:spell:fire-storm.effectSummary: Arrange up to ten 10-foot cubes of flame within range, each sharing at least one face with another cube. Creatures in the area make Dexterity saves, taking 7d10 fire damage on a failure or half on a success. The fire damages objects and ignites unattended flammable objects; you may choose for plant life in the area to be unaffected.

wikidot5e:spell:fireball.effectSummary: A point in range erupts in a 20-foot-radius explosion that spreads around corners. Creatures in the area make Dexterity saves, taking 8d6 fire damage on a failure or half on a success. The blast ignites unattended flammable objects. Each slot level above 3rd adds 1d6 damage.

wikidot5e:spell:fizban-s-platinum-shield.effectSummary: Surround one creature in range, including yourself, with a silvery field that sheds dim light for 5 feet. The protected creature has half cover; resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and poison damage; and an evasion-like benefit, taking no damage on a successful Dexterity save against an effect that normally deals half damage on success and only half on a failed save. On later turns you can use a bonus action to move the field to another creature within 60 feet of the field.

wikidot5e:spell:fizbans-platinum-shield.effectSummary: Surround one creature in range, including yourself, with a silvery field that sheds dim light for 5 feet. The protected creature has half cover; resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and poison damage; and an evasion-like benefit, taking no damage on a successful Dexterity save against an effect that normally deals half damage on success and only half on a failed save. On later turns you can use a bonus action to move the field to another creature within 60 feet of the field.

wikidot5e:spell:flame-arrows.effectSummary: Touch a quiver of arrows or bolts. A ranged weapon hit using ammunition drawn from it deals an extra 1d6 fire damage; the magic ends on that ammunition whether the attack hits or misses. The spell ends after twelve pieces of ammunition have been drawn. Each slot level above 3rd increases the number of affected pieces by two.

wikidot5e:spell:flame-blade.effectSummary: Create a fiery scimitar-like blade in your free hand for the duration. If released it disappears, and you can recreate it as a bonus action. As an action, make a melee spell attack with it; on a hit it deals 3d6 fire damage. It sheds bright light for 10 feet and dim light for another 10 feet. For every two slot levels above 2nd, the damage increases by 1d6.

wikidot5e:spell:flame-stride.effectSummary: For the duration, your speed increases by 20 feet and your movement does not provoke opportunity attacks. A creature or unattended object takes 1d6 fire damage when you move within 5 feet of it, but no creature or object can take this damage more than once per turn. Each slot level above 3rd adds 5 feet to the speed increase and 1d6 to the fire damage.

wikidot5e:spell:flame-strike.effectSummary: A 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder in range is struck by divine fire. Creatures inside make Dexterity saves, taking 4d6 fire plus 4d6 radiant damage on a failure or half on a success. Each slot level above 5th adds 1d6 to either the fire or radiant portion, chosen by you.
